import numpy as np, os, re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); I1=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 input']); O1=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 output'])
I2=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 input']); O2=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 output'])
I3=np.array(G['Demo pair 3 input']); O3=np.array(G['Demo pair 3 output'])
T=np.array(G['Test input'])
for name,I,O in [('d1',I1,O1),('d2',I2,O2),('d3',I3,O3)]:
    H,W=I.shape; cc=Counter(I.flatten())
    # two non-bg colors: shape color (more) & noise
    order=cc.most_common(3)[::-1]
    c0,c1,c2=order[0][0],order[1][0],order[2][0]
    mask=(I==c0)
    ys,xs=np.where(mask); print(name,'shape bbox',(ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()),'noise',c1,'count',cc[c1],'bg',c0,'outcolors',set(O.flatten()))

import numpy as np, os, re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
I2=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 input']); O2=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 output'])
for cwidth in [3,4]:
    P=[]
    for i in range(5):
        row=[]
        for j in range(4):
            w_=min(cwidth*3+j*cwidth,15)-j*cwidth
            B=I2[i*6:(i+1)*6, j*cwidth:min(j*cwidth+w_,15)]
            c1=(B==1).sum()
            row.append(5 if c1 else 8)
        P.append(row)
    print('cw',cwidth,P,'want',O2.tolist())
